snippet.title: Trials HD - Big Thrills: DLC Gameplay Trailer | HD
snippet.description:
With forty new professional tracks lovingly crafted by RedLynx's level designers, the new expansion will bring a whole new world of obsessive challenge and bone-crushing gameplay to the game's large and loyal fan base. 

DOWNLOAD the DLC on Xbox Live Marketplace: http://marketplace.xbox.com/en-US/Product/Trials-HD-Big-Thrills/4cd522ec-2aeb-45db-951c-01786b6dfed3?cid=SLink
